surface_mechanism_description: The generation of S2 species in the H2S plasma leads to the formation of TiS3, while above 100 °C, a transition to the formation of TiS2 occurs. The S2 species in the H2S plasma are speculated to lead to the formation of the TiS3 phase at low temperature. The phase control is achieved by tuning the co-reactant composition and deposition temperature.
evidence: The generation of S2 species in the H2S plasma has been speculated to leads to the formation of amorphous TiS3 by PE-ALD at a deposition temperature of 100 °C. The S2 species in the H2S plasma, as observed by optical emission spectroscopy, has been speculated to lead to the formation of the TiS3 phase at low temperature.
